summary: The prepared main source already contains the issue-specific page-exact paged/hybrid-SWA free-path corrections from upstream PRs 37729 and 37876; no additional runtime change was justified.

tests.what_was_measured: Paged and unified allocator free-segment regressions, including alignment, tail boundaries, grouped frees, shared-page rejection, double-free detection, and hybrid full-side segment frees; 49 tests and 44 subtests passed.
Issue-specific DSPARK/DCP boundary: cleanup after a committed partial tail does not release the same physical allocator page twice.
On one gfx950 GPU, page IDs freed for three independent boundary cases exactly matched a torch.unique reference.

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, one visible GPU; all three page-free reference cases passed. Raw log: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-370c677a68a1/evidence/gpu_page_free_reference.log

remaining_limitations: The original H20 x8 CUDA workload was unavailable; only one AMD gfx950 GPU was assigned.
DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 weights and the reporter's full request stream were unavailable.
The single-GPU allocator fixture does not validate model semantics, CUDA/H20 behavior, tensor parallelism, or long-running distributed serving stability.
